theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_idx_prime_power_row_card
theorems.statement: ∀ (p a : ℕ), p.Prime → 0 < a → Nat.card (Quot (fun v w : {v : ZMod (p ^ a) × ZMod (p ^ a) // ∃ x y : ZMod (p ^ a), x * v.1 + y * v.2 = 1} => ∃ u : (ZMod (p ^ a))ˣ, (u : ZMod (p ^ a)) * v.1.1 = w.1.1 ∧ (u : ZMod (p ^ a)) * v.1.2 = w.1.2)) = p ^ a + p ^ (a - 1)
theorems.natural_summary: Applies the accepted two-chart equivalence, then adds the residue-ring cardinality and the accepted nonunit cardinality.
